metadata.title: Average Sum-Rate of Distributed Alamouti Space--Time Scheme in Two-Way Amplify-and-Forward Relay Networks

extraction_notes.note: The paper's main analytical result (approximate average sum-rate) is an unlabelled numbered equation not named as a result; kept as equation, not claim/theorem.
Section 3 derives the sum-rate as a chain of equations in running text with no proof environment; represented as equation nodes linked by uses edges rather than one proof node.
latex_facts returns the two-row align with labels eq:MGF:X and eq:MGF:Y (rows 27-28) as a single fact; emitted as one equation node with that span.
The three-phase transmission scheme is described in prose with definitions of its signals; modelled as an unmarked algorithm with one step per phase.
